svg.title: Diagrams illustrating the full sets of upper bounds and lower bounds of a subset Y within a larger set X
svg.desc: Top: within X, every element of Y relates to each of several candidates x1, x2, x3 by yRx, so all three belong to the upper bound set Y superscript u. Bottom: each of several candidates relates to every element of Y by xRy, so all three belong to the lower bound set Y superscript l.
svg.text: Upper bounds: y R xₖ for every y ∈ Y, for each xₖ ∈ Yu = {x₁, x₂, x₃}
Lower bounds: xₖ R y for every y ∈ Y, for each xₖ ∈ Yl = {x₁, x₂, x₃}
